describe: The image shows a bullet hole in glass on a pure black background: a small round dark hole at the centre, ringed by a bright white-grey crater of crushed glass and frost speckles. Thin pale cracks radiate outward in all directions, longer toward the edges, with a few pale dots scattered. The glass cracks are cool silvery white and the hole is solid black. Lighting is high contrast, with the brightest areas in the ring around the hole.
